how_adapted: Copied verbatim through the browser (GitHub blob page -> Raw -> select all -> copy -> paste into workspace); not modified. Imported by src/core/layout.js, which builds a dagre graph from the document's shapes and connectors (rankdir TB/LR, nodesep/ranksep = spacing), runs dagre.layout and converts the returned centre coordinates to top-left positions for the layered layout.
notes: Acquired through the GUI browser only. Candidates inspected and rejected: YahyaABOUE/layered-graph-drawing (no LICENSE file, so not reusable). GitHub searches for orthogonal connector routing and mxGraph XML import returned no usable repositories. Everything else is original code written for this task: the CRDT/LWW op model and undo history (src/core/document.js), straight and grid-based orthogonal routing (src/core/route.js), geometry (src/core/geometry.js), draw.io XML parsing and import (src/core/xml.js, src/core/drawio.js), SVG export (src/core/svg.js), snapping (src/core/index.js), HTTP/WebSocket server, persistence and WebSocket framing (src/server.js, src/store.js, src/ws.js), and the browser editor (src/public/).
